headline: You say the right thing
fortune: A friend will need cheering up, and your silly little sentence will make them laugh properly. Mithu will repeat it badly.

headline: The message arrives first
fortune: Someone you were about to miss will message you first. Pretend you were calm about it.

headline: A compliment follows you home
fortune: A stranger or shopkeeper will compliment something you chose. You will remember it at bedtime and smile again.

headline: A tiny stranger approves
fortune: A small child will wave at you like an old friend. You will wave back with unnecessary importance.

headline: An old joke returns
fortune: A friend will send you a joke only the two of you understand. Your laugh will arrive before the explanation.

headline: Your usual is remembered
fortune: Someone will remember exactly how you like your chai. This is one of the purest forms of fame.

headline: Your compliment lands perfectly
fortune: You will praise someone at the exact moment they need it. Their smile will stay with you all afternoon.

headline: The awkward hello improves
fortune: A clumsy little conversation will end with both of you laughing. Mithu calls this excellent social recovery.

headline: Directions come with blessings
fortune: You will ask for directions and receive the route, a shortcut, and advice about lunch. Follow at least two.

headline: The quiet one has the best story
fortune: Someone usually quiet will tell a story so funny that dinner pauses. Ask one more question.

headline: The smallest joke wins
fortune: Your tiniest joke will make the quietest person laugh the loudest. You will think about it for days.

headline: Two words clear the air
fortune: A simple “I was wrong” will make a small tension disappear. Mithu may faint from the maturity.

headline: One extra sweet appears
fortune: A shopkeeper will tuck an extra sweet into your packet with a secret smile. You are now required to have a good day.
